review_scope: Independent of material implementation: all five final images personally viewed against personally inspected M+ completion photograph. Reviewer authored documentation, not an independent authorship review. Parent independently handles numerical geometry/material supports and clean build.

views.front: Three front and four return tan bay groups, pale original cross mullions and true dark backing; dark green original canopy and grey stair. Broad unresolved striped walls stay neutral, no faux narrow white bands.
views.rear: Synthetic rear closure and broad unverified faces neutral; visible continuation of supported bay original members remains disclosed approximation.
views.elevation: Open colonnade retained, no glass filling; incomplete white/tan broad stripe pattern deliberately omitted rather than inaccurately restored. No text or tiny motifs added.
views.source-angle: Limited entry-corner interpretation consistent with source and disclosed coarse geometry; no stray color patches.
views.top: Broad roof/base neutral; dark green canopy remains coarse source-supported shell proxy, no invented glass grid. Overall framing complete.

limitations: Original entry-corner segment only; rear cut is artificial and no compass bearings assigned.
M+ photograph capture date unknown; upload/version timestamp and project dates not capture dates.
2016/2018 sources not reread this pass and no 2026 current-condition claim.
Main broad white/tan bands and two-tone columns lack full original boundaries and are intentionally neutral; original thin relief courses are not used as false broad bands.
Window backing and canopy are opaque composite appearance proxies, not certified glass/transparency.
Original 11.1mm colonnade gap and geometry preserved; no added plaque, motif, railing, texture or courtyard.
Original 0.2235% opening-loss QA preserved without print-QA rerun or actual trial print.
